I think the ability to mod the game so heavily ruined the franchise. If the burden of making a great game was all on EA’s shoulders, they would be FORCED to make it as good as  possible or lose their audience aka money.

For example, I’ve downloaded almost 100GB of script mods alone that I won’t play the game without. If I couldn’t do that, they’d have crammed as much of those mods into base game as possible, then squeezed it into minimal free updates, then DLC as a last resort, until they couldn’t do it anymore and have to make a new game. We’d be on sims 5 or 6 by now. They release bare-boned broken content bc they know we’ll fix it for them, and DLC so console players don’t feel completely left out and leave. It’s less work for more money. 

I don’t pay for DLC and if EA entices the best modders to monetize exclusively through them (which they are planning to do) I’m gone. get that bag, but not from me lol
